name: Moving to the next page shows the next unit range
title: SC-12-02-01 Moving to the next page shows the next unit range
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a directory containing more units than fit on one page
When the manager moves to the next page
Then the directory shows the next page of units
